notes:
Backup drives that drop out mid-transfer no longer cause false alarms, plus faster screens.

- A backup drive that briefly disconnects no longer marks files as changed, and the transfer carries on by itself once it's plugged back in
- Cards are recognised by the clips on them, so a reused card is never mistaken for one from an old wedding
- Each transfer shows its upload speed while uploading
- Faster, smoother screens
- If this update won't install: download SafeStore.dmg from the releases page, quit SafeStore with nothing transferring, then drag the new SafeStore into Applications. Updates work by themselves after that
